Hi Ting,

I've did some further testing with the data provided on the GitHub repository. Analysis of PD and MQ data worked just fine on my system, but for the provided SpectroMine dataset, only SpectroMinetoMSstatsTMTFormat(raw.mine, annotation.mine) worked, whereas proteinSummarization(input.mine) resulted in following error (again data.table seems to be the problem):

INFO  [2021-08-27 11:43:11] ** MSstatsTMT - proteinSummarization function
INFO  [2021-08-27 11:43:11] Summarizing for Run : 1_1 ( 1  of  1 )
  |=================================================================================================================================================| 100%
Error in `[.data.table`(processed, , `:=`(c("PeptideSequence", "Charge"),  :
  Supplied 2 columns to be assigned 7 items. Please see NEWS for v1.12.2.

To make sure, that this error is not specific to my MacBook, I've also tested both datasets on another (Windows-based) System. Again, PD and MQ data worked fine, but the provided SpectroMine dataset got stuck at the proteinSummarization step again (with the identical error message).

I hope, that these additional tests might help you to find the source of the problem error messages I'm currently stuck with...

Best,
Christian

messages.subject: Re: SpectroMinetoMSstatsTMTFormat()
parts:
Hi Christian,

Thank you very much for pointing it out. 
1. The error in SpectroMinetoMSstatsTMTFormat() is due to the inconsistency between column PG.Qvalue and PG.QValue. If you change the column in your raw file from PG.Qvalue to PG.QValue, it should work. 
2. ProteinSummarization() error: This is a new bug for spectromine example file and we will fix it soon.  

Best,
Ting
